description: ENCRYPTED stays set and version stays 2, but the CIPHER_ID sub-field (bits 2-3 of flags, mask 0x000C) is changed from 0 (AES-128-GCM) to 2, a value reserved for future ciphers. With ENCRYPTED set, CIPHER_ID must be 0 or 1; 2 and 3 are rejected, the same principle already applied to reserved flag bits. The CRC is recomputed because flags is part of the header the CRC covers.
